How the warming Great Lakes could herald a new era of supercharged snowstorms
#Canada #ClimateChange kitchener.ctvnews.ca/how-the-warm...

Unfrozen Great Lakes, weak jet stream not keeping the arctic air there, warmer atmosphere with faster moving molecules making energy in the atmosphere, creating larger clouds with more volume of water (because it’s less cold)… this is how global warming gets us 2 45cm snowstorms in 4 days in Ottawa
